title: ZenithVoid
description:
Name: ZenithVoid
Summary: ZenithVoid — Permanent soul progression through 3 tiers of legendary power. Features custom crafting events, lightning strikes, and global broadcasts.
Developer: Kaz (rllybro)
body:
🌀 ZenithVoid: Ultimate Core Progression
ZenithVoid is a lightweight but powerful progression plugin that introduces the legendary Zenith Cores. Tired of losing your potion buffs when you die? ZenithVoid allows you to craft and "consume" powerful cores that grant permanent, tiered status effects that stay with you forever.

🌟 Key Features
Permanent Soul-Binding: Once you right-click a Zenith Core, the power is bound to your UUID forever.

Tiered Progression: Start with basic survival buffs and work your way up to becoming a demi-god.

No Lag & No Particles: Optimized event handling ensures zero server lag and no annoying potion swirls on your screen.

🛠️ The Three Tiers of Power
Each tier requires a specific "base" block in the crafting grid to determine the level of power.

Tier I
Permanent Effects:

⚡ Speed I

⚔️ Strength I

Tier II
Permanent Effects:

⚡ Speed I

⚔️ Strength I

🔥 Fire Resistance I

Tier III
Permanent Effects:

⚡ Speed II

⚔️ Strength II

🔥 Fire Resistance I

🛡️ Resistance I

🧪 How to Use
Crafting: Arrange the ingredients in a crafting table.

Top Row: Enchanted Apple | Nether Star | Enchanted Apple

Middle Row: Diamond Block | Netherite Block | Diamond Block

Bottom Row: Enchanted Apple | Wither Rose | Enchanted Apple

Activation: Hold the Core in your hand and Right-Click.

Ascension: You will hear a chime and see a flame burst—your powers are now active forever!

💬 Support & Community
Join our community to report bugs, suggest Tier IV features, or get help with the plugin!

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/vk6VBpZXEk
